channel.title: Remio Host for Linux
channel.description: Most recent updates for Remio Host on Linux

item.title: Version 2.6.1
item.description:
Remio Host for Linux 2.6.1

Fixes a crash that could close Remio Host just seconds after launch — or any time its server connection dropped. The host now stays running and reconnects on its own. Also includes a fix for a crash when the screen resolution changed as a device connected.

item.title: Version 2.5.0
item.description:
Remio Host for Linux 2.5.0

Remio Host now runs on Raspberry Pi — 64-bit and 32-bit builds as a .deb or an AppImage. You can create a Remio account with just an email and password, straight from the host. If you forward a single UDP port on your router, a connecting device can ask to come in through exactly that port for a direct, sharper connection instead of a relay. Version numbers are now shared across every Remio app, so this jumps from 1.1.3 to 2.5.0.

item.title: Version 1.1.3
item.description:
Remio Host for Linux 1.1.3

More reliable crash reporting so rare issues get tracked down and fixed faster - nothing for you to do.

item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description:
Remio Host for Linux 1.1.2

Fixed Wayland screen sharing failing right after granting permission - the app now uses your system screen-sharing stack, so clicking Share once just works

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
Remio Host for Linux 1.1.1

Screen sharing on Wayland is now a clear one-time setup step with a Grant button - no more surprise system prompts, and the host only shows Ready to stream when sharing is actually set up. Terminal installs can grant with remio-host --grant-screen.

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
Remio Host for Linux 1.1.0

Wayland support: Remio Host now shares your screen on Wayland sessions - the default on modern Ubuntu and Fedora - using the system screen-sharing service. Approve the share prompt once and Remio remembers it. Xorg keeps working exactly as before.

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
Remio Host for Linux 1.0.1

Clear guidance when running in a Wayland session: Remio Host now detects it at startup and shows exactly how to switch to an Xorg session, instead of streaming a silent black screen

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
Remio Host for Linux 1.0.0

First production release of Remio Host for Linux — stream your Linux desktop to iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, or Windows at up to 4K 60 fps with instant QR pairing, full mouse, keyboard and gamepad control, clipboard sync, file transfer, and dynamic resolution that follows your device's screen. Ships as a portable AppImage for virtually any modern distro, plus a .deb for Ubuntu 24.04 and newer.
